title: CRL: delta entries cloned on every check
description:
Location: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs, verify_delta_crl_and_collect() (line ~1078)

Every call to check_revocation / check_revocation_against_anchor clones the entire delta CRL revoked-certificates Vec via:
  Ok(delta_crl.tbs_cert_list.revoked_certificates.clone().unwrap_or_default())

The code already notes this (line 1070-1077 comment) and calls it 'deferred as a low-priority perf cleanup'. The delta CRL is already pre-parsed and stored as &self.delta_crl; verify_delta_crl_and_collect could return a borrowed &[RevokedCert] slice reference instead of cloning the Vec. Both call sites (check_revocation line 648 and check_revocation_against_anchor line 842) would use the slice in-scope before dropping it.

What goes wrong: on a CRL with thousands of revoked entries, each check_revocation call allocates and copies every RevokedCert. For batch validation (verify_batch) this multiplies to O(certs_in_batch * revoked_entries) allocations.
